name: Butyltolylquinuclidine
summary: 2-Butyl-3-(p-tolyl)quinuclidine (BTQ) is a stimulant dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI). It is one of a number of substituted quinuclidine derivatives developed as potential medications for the treatment of cocaine abuse, and produces similar effects to cocaine in animal studies, although milder and longer-lasting.

pharmacology.text: 2-Butyl-3-(p-tolyl)quinuclidine (BTQ) is a stimulant dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI).

uses.text: It is one of a number of substituted quinuclidine derivatives developed as potential medications for the treatment of cocaine abuse, and produces similar effects to cocaine in animal studies, although milder and longer-lasting.

summaryZh: 2-丁基-3-(4-甲苯基)奎寧環（英語：2-Butyl-3-quinuclidine，Butyltolylquinuclidine，縮寫BTQ）是一種具有興奮劑功能的多巴胺再攝取抑制劑，是含奎寧環的藥物之一，是治療古柯鹼濫用的潛在藥物之一，更加溫和持久，在動物研究中產生與古柯鹼相似的效果。
summaryZhHans: 2-丁基-3-(4-甲苯基)奎宁环（英语：2-Butyl-3-quinuclidine，Butyltolylquinuclidine，缩写BTQ）是一种具有兴奋剂功能的多巴胺再摄取抑制剂，是含奎宁环的药物之一，是治疗可卡因滥用的潜在药物之一，更加温和持久，在动物研究中产生与可卡因相似的效果。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. In animals it produced cocaine-like effects, milder and longer lasting. Dopamine reuptake inhibitors can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。在動物身上它產生類似古柯鹼的作用，但較溫和而持久。多巴胺回收抑制劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、失眠與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。在动物身上它产生类似古柯碱的作用，但较温和而持久。多巴胺回收抑制剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、失眠与焦虑。

fact.en: It is built on quinuclidine, a rigid cage of carbon and nitrogen. It was one of a series made in the hope of finding a treatment for cocaine dependence, a drug that would occupy the same transporter more gently.
fact.zh: 它建立在奎寧環這個剛硬的碳氮籠狀結構上。它是為尋找古柯鹼成癮治療藥物而合成的系列之一，構想是用更溫和的方式佔住同一個轉運體。
fact.zhHans: 它创建在奎宁环这个刚硬的碳氮笼状结构上。它是为寻找古柯碱成瘾治疗药物而合成的系列之一，构想是用更温和的方式占住同一个转运体。
